envelope.description: Add the synchronous shared request builder

body.title: Add the synchronous shared request builder
body.summary: Add buildIntentFromRequest in src/analyze/context/request.ts: builds the unsized intent from a request or the old flat fields, sets context and scopeSource, defaults target to code, ignores flat target and scope when a request is present, refuses an empty question, an over-long context and a request with a differing focus; it reads no file system or index.
acceptanceChecks: the same request yields the same intent for the step tool's and the one-shot tool's inputs
a prompt-only call gets the workspace scope and scopeSource prompt
a request ignores a flat target and size

tests.name: request.test.ts: buildIntentFromRequest makes the same intent for a request through both tools, defaults target to code, ignores a flat target and size, refuses an empty question, an over-long context and a differing focus, and keeps context off scopeRef
